text: Before you begin, take a little space to arrive.
Feel your feet, or the support beneath your body. Let your hands rest for a moment.
Notice your breathing. You do not have to change it.
Whatever you are bringing to your work today, you can begin from here.
Let the whole project wait for a moment. Bring to mind just one thing you would like to work on.
What is the smallest useful beginning? A sentence. A sketch. A question. Your own first step.
You do not have to know how it will turn out.
Imagine giving that first step a little curiosity, rather than asking it to be perfect.
Notice the space around you again. Let your gaze find something steady.
Move your hands gently. Let your attention return to what is in front of you.
Begin when you are ready. One small step is enough to start.
